sentences.en: Clerks with sticky fingers won't keep their jobs for long.
sentences.zh: 贪污的职员不会干太久。

sentences.en: I can't get this sticky ball out of my hand.
sentences.zh: 我这黏糊糊的球拿都拿不掉。

sentences.en: Yanni's hands are sticky. He must have been eating figs.
sentences.zh: 亚尼的手好黏啊。他肯定是刚吃石榴了。

senses.zh: 黏性的，涂有黏性物质的；（皮肤因热而）黏湿的；（天气）湿热的，闷热的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：stick（粘住）+y（…的）→黏性的
